newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's $1 bln shelf declared effective.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's $1 bln shelf declared effective.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Friday the Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the company's shelf registration for up to $1 billion of debt securities.
The registration was filed on October 15.

The fast-food company said it plans to use proceeds for debt refinancings, capital expenditures and purchase of McDonald's common stock. It said the securities issued may be denominated in any currency at the company's option.
When combined with the remaining unused amount of a previously issued shelf registration, the company will have about $1.2 billion available that could be issued.
